title: AET-B S3: the review package and verdict record (a review bound to the exact candidate, by a run that is not the author's, with complete re-review and staleness)
objective: Close #359. Build S3 of the AET-B design. badf_gate.py review-package builds the candidate from base..head (work/<WP>/ and the lockfile excluded) and refuses a non-ancestor, empty or unknown range. A verdict at work/<WP>/reviews/REV-NN.json, against schemas/review-verdict.schema.json, is validated by repo: bound to its package digest, authoring and reviewing runs distinct, findings or non-coverage stated, APPROVE never beside a blocking finding, and a re-review dispositions every prior OPEN finding exactly once. badf_gate.py review-check reads the latest verdict against the candidate now: CURRENT, STALE or NONE. Carry the WP-2026-0157 reconcile.
business_value: Independent review becomes a record bound to what was reviewed and by whom, rather than a claim. A review by the author's own run, a stale review of a moved candidate, and a re-review that silently drops a finding all become refusals. S2's dispatch envelope can cite this record.
in_scope: scripts/badf_gate.py: build_review_package, check_review_verdict, verify_review_verdicts (wired into validate_repo), review_check, and the review-package / review-check subcommands
carry the WP-2026-0157 reconcile (CLOSED, landed_as 39bd569, composition_verified true)
out_of_scope: S2, S4 and S5 (separate work packages)
any change to G08 dossier validation or the independent-review evidence binding
any gate that requires a verdict before merge
identity: a run id distinguishes sessions, not people (#261)
any change to C3's required roles, the authority matrix, docs/14 or AGENTS.md
the G07 self-dossier -- assembly is HUMAN_REQUIRED; declared, not worked around
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: review-package refuses a non-ancestor, empty or unknown range; its package digest is reproducible

AC-2: repo refuses a verdict whose package digest does not recompute, whose authoring and reviewing runs are equal, with neither findings nor non-coverage, or whose APPROVE contradicts a blocking finding
AC-3: a re-review leaving a prior OPEN finding undispositioned, or dispositioning one that was not OPEN, is refused; a re-review cycle or two unrelated chains is refused
AC-4: review-check reports CURRENT before the candidate moves and STALE after, on a real git repository; recording the verdict does not move it
AC-6: WP-2026-0157 reconcile carried; badf_gate.py repo PASS; composed suite green in CI
evidence: composition record + CI compose composition: CURRENT and suite OK

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: C3, because this work package edits an enforcement surface (scripts/badf_gate.py) and S1 binds it. Merge authority: none given for this work package; the PR waits for the operator. The C3 human-reserved approvals at G07 are a separate gate and are not claimed here.
